source: ## 1. Import libraries and define source-parsing utilities

raw_path = resolve_csv("RAW_CSV_PATH", RAW_FILENAME)
source_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()



for source_encoding in ("utf-8-sig", "utf-8", "cp1252"):
    try:
        raw_df = pd.read_csv(raw_path, encoding=source_encoding)
        break
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        continue
else:
    raise UnicodeError("The source CSV could not be decoded.")



expected_columns = [
    "Unnamed: 0",
    "TURNI 2026 FARMACIE BOLOGNA - AREA CITTA'",
    "Unnamed: 2", "Unnamed: 3", "Unnamed: 4", "Unnamed: 5",
    "Unnamed: 6", "nT", "Unnamed: 8", "Unnamed: 9", "Unnamed: 10",
]
require(list(raw_df.columns) == expected_columns, "Unexpected source CSV schema.")
source_columns = list(raw_df.columns)


raw_df.insert(0, "source_row", np.arange(len(raw_df), dtype=int))

print("Loaded:", raw_path.name)
print("Encoding:", source_encoding)
print("Shape:", (len(raw_df), len(source_columns)))
print("SHA-256:", source_hash)

cleaned_df = raw_df[
    ["source_row", source_columns[0], source_columns[1], source_columns[6], source_columns[7]]
].copy()
cleaned_df.columns = ["source_row", "pharmacy_name", "address", "D", "nT"]

non_rotation_mask = (
    cleaned_df["pharmacy_name"].astype("string")
    .str.contains("non nei turni", case=False, na=False)
)
removed_non_rotation = int(non_rotation_mask.sum())
excluded_non_rotation_private = cleaned_df.loc[
    non_rotation_mask, ["source_row", "pharmacy_name", "address"]
].copy()
cleaned_df = cleaned_df.loc[~non_rotation_mask].copy()

name_present = cleaned_df["pharmacy_name"].notna() & cleaned_df["pharmacy_name"].astype(str).str.strip().ne("")
address_present = cleaned_df["address"].notna() & cleaned_df["address"].astype(str).str.strip().ne("")
access_mode = cleaned_df["D"].astype("string").str.strip().str.upper()


assignment_mask = access_mode.isin(ACCESS_MODE_MEANING)
require(
    not (assignment_mask & ~(name_present & address_present)).any(),
    "A P/C assignment row is missing a pharmacy name or address.",
)

assignments = cleaned_df.loc[assignment_mask].copy()
assignments["access_mode"] = access_mode.loc[assignment_mask]
assignments["pharmacy_name_clean"] = assignments["pharmacy_name"].map(clean_display)
assignments["address_clean"] = assignments["address"].map(clean_display)
assignments["pharmacy_key"] = assignments["pharmacy_name"].map(normalized_key)
assignments["address_key"] = assignments["address"].map(normalized_key)

print("Observed non-rotation facilities (excluded, tracked separately):", removed_non_rotation)
print("Rotation assignment rows:", len(assignments))

existing_pharmacy_ids, existing_location_ids = {}, {}
next_pharmacy_number, next_location_number = 1, 1


existing_mapping_path = os.environ.get("EXISTING_MAPPING_PATH")

if existing_mapping_path:
    existing_mapping = pd.read_csv(existing_mapping_path)
    existing_mapping["pharmacy_key"] = existing_mapping["pharmacy_name"].map(normalized_key)
    existing_mapping["address_key"] = existing_mapping["address"].map(normalized_key)
    existing_pharmacy_ids = (
        existing_mapping.drop_duplicates("pharmacy_key")
        .set_index("pharmacy_key")["pharmacy_id"].to_dict()
    )
    existing_location_ids = (
        existing_mapping.drop_duplicates(["pharmacy_key", "address_key"])
        .set_index(["pharmacy_key", "address_key"])["location_id"].to_dict()
    )

for column, prefix in [("pharmacy_id", "P"), ("location_id", "L")]:
    if existing_mapping_path:
        require(existing_mapping[column].astype(str).str.fullmatch(prefix + r"\d+").all(), "Invalid existing IDs.")
if existing_mapping_path:
    require(existing_mapping.groupby("pharmacy_key")["pharmacy_id"].nunique().le(1).all(), "One name maps to multiple IDs.")
    require(existing_mapping.groupby("pharmacy_id")["pharmacy_key"].nunique().le(1).all(), "Pharmacy ID collision.")
    require(existing_mapping.groupby(["pharmacy_key", "address_key"])["location_id"].nunique().le(1).all(), "Location mapping conflict.")
    require(not existing_mapping[["pharmacy_key","address_key","location_id"]].drop_duplicates().duplicated("location_id").any(), "Location ID collision.")
next_pharmacy_number = 1 + max([int(v[1:]) for v in existing_pharmacy_ids.values()], default=0)
next_location_number = 1 + max([int(v[1:]) for v in existing_location_ids.values()], default=0)

mapping_base = (
    assignments[["pharmacy_key", "address_key", "pharmacy_name_clean", "address_clean"]]
    .drop_duplicates(["pharmacy_key", "address_key"], keep="first")
    .copy()
)



pharmacy_id_map = dict(existing_pharmacy_ids)
for key in mapping_base["pharmacy_key"].drop_duplicates():
    if key not in pharmacy_id_map:
        pharmacy_id_map[key] = f"P{next_pharmacy_number:04d}"
        next_pharmacy_number += 1

location_id_map = dict(existing_location_ids)
for pair in mapping_base[["pharmacy_key", "address_key"]].itertuples(index=False, name=None):
    if pair not in location_id_map:
        location_id_map[pair] = f"L{next_location_number:04d}"
        next_location_number += 1

mapping_df = mapping_base.assign(
    pharmacy_id=mapping_base["pharmacy_key"].map(pharmacy_id_map),
    location_id=[location_id_map[p] for p in mapping_base[["pharmacy_key", "address_key"]].itertuples(index=False, name=None)],
).rename(columns={"pharmacy_name_clean": "pharmacy_name", "address_clean": "address"})[
    ["pharmacy_name", "address", "pharmacy_id", "location_id"]
]

assignments["pharmacy_id"] = assignments["pharmacy_key"].map(pharmacy_id_map)
assignments["location_id"] = [
    location_id_map[pair] for pair in assignments[["pharmacy_key", "address_key"]].itertuples(index=False, name=None)
]

print("Pharmacy IDs:", mapping_df["pharmacy_id"].nunique())
print("Location IDs:", mapping_df["location_id"].nunique())

date_pattern = re.compile(r"^\s*(\d{2}/\d{2}/(?:\d{2}|\d{4}))\s*-\s*(\d{2}/\d{2}/(?:\d{2}|\d{4}))\s*$")


def parse_date(value):
    for fmt in ("%d/%m/%Y", "%d/%m/%y"):
        parsed = pd.to_datetime(str(value).strip(), format=fmt, errors="coerce")
        if pd.notna(parsed):
            return pd.Timestamp(parsed)
    return pd.NaT



date_rows = []
for row_index, value in cleaned_df["address"].items():
    if pd.isna(value):
        continue
    match = date_pattern.fullmatch(str(value))
    if match:
        date_rows.append((row_index, match.group(1), match.group(2)))
require(len(date_rows) > 0, "No weekly blocks were detected.")



working_df = cleaned_df.copy()
assignment_by_source = assignments.set_index("source_row")
for column in ["pharmacy_id", "location_id", "access_mode"]:
    working_df[column] = working_df["source_row"].map(assignment_by_source[column])

records = []
observed_nt_sequence = []
for week_position, (start_index, start_text, end_text) in enumerate(date_rows):
    
    end_index = date_rows[week_position + 1][0] if week_position + 1 < len(date_rows) else np.inf
    block = working_df.loc[(working_df.index >= start_index) & (working_df.index < end_index)].copy()

    
    header_text = block["pharmacy_name"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
    h24_headers = block.index[header_text.str.contains("24 ORE SU 24", regex=False)].tolist()
    standard_headers = block.index[
        header_text.str.contains("IN TURNO SETTIMANALE", regex=False)
        & ~header_text.str.contains("24 ORE SU 24", regex=False)
    ].tolist()
    require(len(h24_headers) == 1 and len(standard_headers) == 1, "Invalid weekly shift headers.")
    require(h24_headers[0] < standard_headers[0], "Weekly headers are reversed.")

    
    nt_values_in_block = pd.to_numeric(block["nT"], errors="coerce").dropna().unique()
    require(len(nt_values_in_block) == 1, "Invalid nT value.")
    current_nt = int(nt_values_in_block[0])
    observed_nt_sequence.append(current_nt)

    week_start = parse_date(start_text)
    week_end = parse_date(end_text)
    require(pd.notna(week_start) and pd.notna(week_end), "Invalid weekly dates.")
    iso = week_start.isocalendar()
    week_id = f"{iso.year}-W{iso.week:02d}"
    current_shift_type = None

    
    
    
    for _, row in block.iterrows():
        text = "" if pd.isna(row["pharmacy_name"]) else str(row["pharmacy_name"]).strip().upper()
        if "24 ORE SU 24" in text:
            current_shift_type = "H24"
            continue
        if "IN TURNO SETTIMANALE" in text and "24 ORE SU 24" not in text:
            current_shift_type = "STANDARD"
            continue
        if pd.isna(row["pharmacy_id"]):
            continue
        require(current_shift_type in {"H24", "STANDARD"}, "Assignment precedes shift header.")
        records.append({
            "source_row": int(row["source_row"]), "week_id": week_id,
            "week_start": week_start, "week_end": week_end, "nT": current_nt,
            "pharmacy_id": row["pharmacy_id"], "location_id": row["location_id"],
            "shift_type": current_shift_type, "access_mode": row["access_mode"],
        })

provisional_df = pd.DataFrame(records)
require(not provisional_df.empty, "No assignments were reconstructed from the weekly blocks.")
print("Weekly blocks detected:", len(date_rows))
print("Reconstructed assignment rows:", len(provisional_df))

def group_period_scores(frame, period_range):
    scores = []
    for period in period_range:
        residues = ((frame["nT"].astype(int) - 1) % period) + 1
        counts = (
            pd.DataFrame({"pharmacy_id": frame["pharmacy_id"], "residue": residues})
            .value_counts().rename("count").reset_index()
        )
        dominant_rows = counts.groupby("pharmacy_id")["count"].max().sum()
        scores.append({"candidate_period": period, "membership_purity": float(dominant_rows / len(frame))})
    return pd.DataFrame(scores).sort_values(
        ["membership_purity", "candidate_period"], ascending=[False, True]
    ).reset_index(drop=True)


unique_nt_count = int(provisional_df["nT"].nunique())
require(unique_nt_count >= 3, "At least three distinct nT values are needed to infer group recurrence.")
candidate_range = range(2, unique_nt_count)

group_scores_df = group_period_scores(provisional_df, candidate_range)
observed_group_period = int(group_scores_df.iloc[0]["candidate_period"])
observed_group_purity = float(group_scores_df.iloc[0]["membership_purity"])
runner_up_purity = float(group_scores_df.iloc[1]["membership_purity"]) if len(group_scores_df) > 1 else float("nan")

print("Top candidate period:", observed_group_period, f"(purity={observed_group_purity:.6f})")
print("Runner-up purity:", f"{runner_up_purity:.6f}", "-> raw margin:", f"{observed_group_purity - runner_up_purity:.6f}")
display(group_scores_df.head(10))

rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=0)
PERMUTATIONS = 500

pharmacy_codes, unique_pharmacies = pd.factorize(provisional_df["pharmacy_id"], sort=True)
labels = np.sort(provisional_df["nT"].unique())
label_index = np.searchsorted(labels, provisional_df["nT"].to_numpy())
def fast_best_purity(nt_column):
    scores = []
    for period in candidate_range:
        residues = (nt_column - 1) % period
        counts = np.bincount(pharmacy_codes * period + residues,
                             minlength=len(unique_pharmacies)*period).reshape(-1, period)
        scores.append(counts.max(axis=1).sum()/len(provisional_df))
    return max(scores)
require(np.isclose(fast_best_purity(provisional_df["nT"].to_numpy()), observed_group_purity), "Purity implementation mismatch.")
null_best_purities = np.array([fast_best_purity(rng.permutation(labels)[label_index]) for _ in range(PERMUTATIONS)])
permutation_exceedances = int((null_best_purities >= observed_group_purity).sum())
permutation_p_value = (permutation_exceedances + 1)/(PERMUTATIONS + 1)
null_mean, null_max = float(null_best_purities.mean()), float(null_best_purities.max())
require(permutation_p_value < 0.01, "The candidate period lacks support under the pattern-label null.")
print(f"Observed period={observed_group_period}, purity={observed_group_purity:.6f}")
print(f"Pattern-label null: mean={null_mean:.6f}, max={null_max:.6f}, B={PERMUTATIONS}, b={permutation_exceedances}")
print(f"Corrected Monte Carlo p-value={permutation_p_value:.6f}; exploratory evidence, not administrative proof.")
## 8. Finalize rotation group/round and the canonical schedule

provisional_df["rotation_group"] = ((provisional_df["nT"].astype(int) - 1) % observed_group_period) + 1
provisional_df["rotation_round"] = ((provisional_df["nT"].astype(int) - 1) // observed_group_period) + 1

canonical_columns = [
    "source_row", "week_id", "week_start", "week_end", "nT",
    "rotation_group", "rotation_round", "pharmacy_id", "location_id",
    "shift_type", "access_mode",
]
canonical_df = provisional_df[canonical_columns]

require(len(canonical_df) == len(assignments), "Canonical row count mismatch.")
require(not canonical_df.duplicated(["week_id", "pharmacy_id"]).any(), "Duplicate pharmacy-week.")
require(canonical_df["shift_type"].isin(["H24", "STANDARD"]).all(), "Invalid shift type.")
require(canonical_df["access_mode"].isin(ACCESS_MODE_MEANING).all(), "Invalid access mode.")
require(not canonical_df.isna().any().any(), "Canonical data contains missing values.")

week_fields = ["week_start", "week_end", "nT", "rotation_group", "rotation_round"]
require((canonical_df.groupby("week_id")[week_fields].nunique() == 1).all().all(), "Inconsistent week fields.")
weeks_df = canonical_df[["week_id"] + week_fields].drop_duplicates().sort_values("week_start").reset_index(drop=True)
require((weeks_df["week_start"].diff().dropna().dt.days == 7).all(), "Week starts are not seven days apart.")

boundary_days = (weeks_df["week_end"] - weeks_df["week_start"]).dt.days
boundary_exceptions = weeks_df.loc[boundary_days.ne(7), "week_id"].tolist()
require(weeks_df["week_start"].dt.dayofweek.eq(0).all(), "A start is not Monday.")
require(weeks_df["week_end"].iloc[:-1].reset_index(drop=True).equals(weeks_df["week_start"].iloc[1:].reset_index(drop=True)), "Calendar boundary discontinuity.")
require(set(observed_nt_sequence) == set(range(1, unique_nt_count + 1)), "Nonconsecutive nT labels.")
require(all(b == a % unique_nt_count + 1 for a,b in zip(observed_nt_sequence, observed_nt_sequence[1:])), "Invalid nT progression.")

summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "metric": ["assignments", "weeks", "rotating_pharmacies", "locations", "H24", "STANDARD", "P", "C"],
    "value": [
        len(canonical_df), canonical_df["week_id"].nunique(), canonical_df["pharmacy_id"].nunique(),
        canonical_df["location_id"].nunique(), canonical_df["shift_type"].eq("H24").sum(),
        canonical_df["shift_type"].eq("STANDARD").sum(), canonical_df["access_mode"].eq("P").sum(),
        canonical_df["access_mode"].eq("C").sum(),
    ],
})
display(summary)
if boundary_exceptions:
    print("Boundary exception (week span != 7 days), left as a known review item:", boundary_exceptions)

observed_profile = {
    "profile_type": "observed_not_prespecified",
    "source_file": raw_path.name,
    "source_sha256": source_hash,
    "assignments": int(len(canonical_df)),
    "weeks": int(len(weeks_df)),
    "rotating_pharmacies": int(canonical_df["pharmacy_id"].nunique()),
    "locations": int(canonical_df["location_id"].nunique()),
    "non_rotation_facilities": int(removed_non_rotation),
    "group_period_candidate": observed_group_period,
    "group_membership_purity": observed_group_purity,
    "group_period_permutation_p_value": permutation_p_value,
    "group_period_permutations_run": PERMUTATIONS,
    "source_encoding": source_encoding,
    "candidate_period_min": min(candidate_range),
    "candidate_period_max": max(candidate_range),
    "permutation_random_seed": 0,
    "null_best_purity_mean": null_mean,
    "null_best_purity_max": null_max,
    "group_period_permutation_exceedances": permutation_exceedances,
    "permutation_null": "exchangeable nT labels across intact patterns; repeated-week membership preserved",
    "canonical_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical_df.to_csv(index=False).encode()).hexdigest(),
    "boundary_exceptions": boundary_exceptions,
}

pseudonymized_df = assignments[["source_row", "pharmacy_id", "location_id", "access_mode"]].reset_index(drop=True)

pseudonymized_df.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / "pseudonymized_assignments.csv", index=False)
canonical_df.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / "canonical_schedule.csv", index=False)
Path(OUTPUT_DIR / "observed_data_profile.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(observed_profile, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
)
mapping_df.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / "mapping_PRIVATE.csv", index=False)
excluded_non_rotation_private.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / "excluded_non_rotation_PRIVATE.csv", index=False)

print("Saved public files to", OUTPUT_DIR.resolve())
print("Saved private files (do not share):", "mapping_PRIVATE.csv, excluded_non_rotation_PRIVATE.csv")

from validation import write_stage
write_stage(0, [raw_path], ['output/canonical_schedule.csv', 'output/pseudonymized_assignments.csv', 'output/observed_data_profile.json', 'output/mapping_PRIVATE.csv', 'output/excluded_non_rotation_PRIVATE.csv'])
